# microsoft_teams

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ADD_CHAT_MEMBER
Tool to add a conversationMember to a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when adding a user to an existing chat conversation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddChatMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id",
    "user_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Roles",
      "examples": [
        [
          "owner"
        ],
        [
          "guest"
        ],
        []
      ],
      "description": "Roles to assign to the member. Valid values are 'owner' or 'guest'. Leave empty to add as a standard member (not owner or guest)."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:cf6dec80624a45d798eaf23390645655@thread.v2",
        "19:meeting_MGQ4OGJkZTgtYzE0Mi00YjM2LTg5NTctM2Q5ZjEyYjhhYjM2@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to which the member will be added."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "dfce5c6f-1901-48f6-bf9f-74ba8b05fd10",
        "user@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's Graph ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) to add to the chat."
    },
    "visible_history_start_date_time": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Visible History Start Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Optional. Timestamp denoting how far back a conversation's history is shared with the conversation member. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2021-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Only settable for chat members."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**

```json
  "$defs": {
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ADD_TAB
Tool to add a new tab to a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to pin an app or website as a tab in a channel.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTabRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id",
    "display_name",
    "teams_app_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707",
        "e4e57af8-cff8-4557-af89-a43a6f961f32"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the team containing the channel where the tab will be added."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:079fd66c7bf04c07a21430a9a32c2130@thread.tacv2",
        "19:04e881b862664873b6e97eeeb6961e5e@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel where the tab will be added. This is typically in the format '19:xxx@thread.tacv2' for standard channels."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Test Tab via API",
        "Project Dashboard",
        "My Website"
      ],
      "maxLength": 128,
      "description": "The display name for the tab as it will appear to users in Microsoft Teams."
    },
    "teams_app_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Teams App Id",
      "examples": [
        "com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.web",
        "com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.wiki",
        "com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.planner"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier or catalog reference of the Teams app to add as a tab. Common values: 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.web' for website tabs, 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.wiki' for Wiki, 'com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.planner' for Planner. The app must be installed in the team or available in the app catalog."
    },
    "configuration": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TabConfiguration",
      "properties": {
        "entityId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Entity Id",
          "examples": [
            "test-entity-123",
            "2DCA2E6C7A10415CAF6B8AB6661B3154"
          ],
          "description": "Identifier for the entity hosted by the tab provider. Required for some apps, optional for others (like website tabs)."
        },
        "removeUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Remove Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://www.example.com/remove"
          ],
          "description": "URL called by Teams client when a tab is removed. Optional; can be null for many tab types."
        },
        "contentUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://www.example.com",
            "https://learn.microsoft.com"
          ],
          "description": "URL used for rendering tab contents in Teams. Required for website tabs and custom apps. Must be HTTPS."
        },
        "websiteUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Website Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://www.example.com",
            "https://learn.microsoft.com"
          ],
          "description": "URL for showing tab contents outside of Teams. Optional; used when users want to view content in a browser."
        }
      },
      "description": "Configuration settings for the tab.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for adding a tab to a Microsoft Teams channel."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ADD_TEAM_MEMBER
Tool to add a user to a Microsoft Teams team. Use when granting or updating membership for a user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTeamMemberRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "user_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "roles": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "const": "owner"
      },
      "title": "Roles",
      "examples": [
        [
          "owner"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Roles to assign to the member. Only 'owner' is supported. Omit or leave empty to add as a standard member.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Roles",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose if this person should be an owner. Leave empty to add them as a standard member."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "ee0f5ae2-8bc6-4ae5-8466-7daeebbfa062"
      ],
      "description": "The unique ID (GUID) of the Microsoft Team to which the member will be added.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific team you want to add the person to. Paste the Team\u2019s ID (a long string of letters and numbers) so we update the right team."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5",
        "user@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "The user's Graph ID (GUID) or userPrincipalName (email) to add to the team.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Who you want to add. Enter the person\u2019s Microsoft 365 user ID (GUID) or simply their email address."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ADD_TEAM_MEMBERS_BULK
Tool to add multiple members to a Microsoft Teams team in a single operation. Use when adding several users at once to improve efficiency.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTeamMembersBulkRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "values"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "values": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ConversationMember",
        "required": [
          "user@odata.bind"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "roles": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "title": "Roles",
            "examples": [
              [],
              [
                "owner"
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Roles to assign to the member. Valid values are 'owner' or leave empty for standard member. Multiple roles can be assigned."
          },
          "@odata.type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "@Odata.Type",
            "default": "#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember",
            "examples": [
              "#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember"
            ],
            "description": "The OData type identifier. Must be '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember' for Azure AD user members."
          },
          "user@odata.bind": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "User@Odata.Bind",
            "examples": [
              "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/12141280-112a-4976-b332-d1e6ca13c233",
              "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('user@contoso.com')"
            ],
            "description": "Reference to the user resource to add. Format: 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{user-id}' or 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('{user-id}')'"
          },
          "visibleHistoryStartDateTime": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Visible History Start Date Time",
            "examples": [
              "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z"
            ],
            "description": "Optional timestamp denoting how far back a conversation's history is shared with the member. Must be in ISO 8601 format. Only settable for members of a chat."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a conversation member to add to a team."
      },
      "title": "Values",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Array of conversation members to add to the team. Each member must specify the user reference and optional roles."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the team to add members to."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_ARCHIVE_CHANNEL
Tool to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to archive a specific channel within a team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ArchiveChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the team containing the channel to archive."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "pattern": "^19:[^@]+@thread\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "19:079fd66c7bf04c07a21430a9a32c2130@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel to archive. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:079fd66c7bf04c07a21430a9a32c2130@thread.tacv2')."
    },
    "should_set_spo_site_read_only_for_members": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Should Set Spo Site Read Only For Members",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        false,
        true
      ],
      "description": "If true, sets the SharePoint site to read-only for team members when archiving the channel. Default is false."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema to archive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CHATS_GET_ALL_CHATS
Retrieves all Microsoft Teams chats a specified user is part of, supporting filtering, property selection, and pagination.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAllChatsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 50,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        25,
        50
      ],
      "description": "The page size (number of chats per API request) for pagination. Default is 50. Microsoft Graph enforces a maximum of 50 per request. Note: This action auto-paginates and returns chats up to the 'limit' parameter. The 'top' parameter only controls how many chats are fetched per API call, not the total number of chats returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many chats to fetch per API request (maximum 50). This controls pagination efficiency, not total results. Use 'limit' to control total results returned."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10,
        50,
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum total number of chats to return. If not specified (None), all chats are returned through auto-pagination. Use this as a safety valve to restrict total data returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Maximum total number of chats to return. Leave empty to get all chats."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "chatType eq 'group'",
        "topic eq 'Project Updates'",
        "installedApps/any(a:a/teamsApp/id eq '608d8644-acb1-4ab0-bca5-66fbb6ed62aa')"
      ],
      "description": "OData filter query string (do not include '$filter='). Supports filtering by chat properties like 'topic', 'chatType' (e.g., \"chatType eq 'group'\", \"topic eq 'Project X'\"), and 'installedApps/any(...)' for app-based filtering. Note: Filtering by 'members' (a navigation property) is NOT supported - to filter by member, retrieve all chats and filter client-side, or use $expand=members.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter",
      "human_parameter_description": "OData filter to narrow results. Supports filtering by topic, chatType, and installedApps. Member-based filtering is NOT supported directly - use $expand=members and filter client-side."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Select",
      "default": [],
      "examples": [
        [
          "id",
          "topic",
          "lastMessagePreview"
        ],
        [
          "webUrl",
          "chatType"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of specific Microsoft Graph chat resource properties to retrieve (e.g., 'id', 'topic'). If omitted or empty, a default set of properties is returned. Each string in the list should be a valid property name.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific chat fields you want returned (for example, id, topic, lastMessagePreview). Leave this empty to use the default set of fields."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The ID or user principal name (UPN) of the user whose chats are to be retrieved. Use 'me' to specify the currently authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose chats you want to retrieve. Use 'me' to get your own chats."
    }
  }
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "Chat": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Chat",
      "required": [
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CHATS_GET_ALL_MESSAGES
DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead. Retrieves all messages from a specified Microsoft Teams chat using the Microsoft Graph API, automatically handling pagination; ensure `chat_id` is valid and OData expressions in `filter` or `select` are correct.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetAllMessagesRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 50,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        10
      ],
      "description": "Number of messages to retrieve per API page request. Microsoft Graph API maximum is 50 per page. This controls the page size for pagination, not the total number of messages returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many messages to fetch per page (maximum 50). This controls API pagination batch size. Use 'limit' parameter to control total messages returned."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum total number of messages to retrieve across all pages. If not specified, all available messages are returned (following pagination). Use this to limit the total results when you don't need the full history.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Total Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Maximum total messages to return. Leave empty to get all messages. Set a value (e.g., 100) to limit total results for performance."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "lastModifiedDateTime gt 2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "createdDateTime lt 2024-12-31T23:59:59.999Z"
      ],
      "description": "OData v4.0 filter query string for messages. FILTER RESTRICTIONS: For 'lastModifiedDateTime', both 'gt' (greater than) and 'lt' (less than) operators are supported. For 'createdDateTime', ONLY 'lt' (less than) is supported - 'gt' (greater than) is NOT allowed and will cause an API error. Must be used with 'orderby' on the same property or filter will be ignored.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional filter to narrow which messages are returned. For lastModifiedDateTime: use 'gt' or 'lt'. For createdDateTime: ONLY 'lt' is allowed (NOT 'gt'). Must be used together with orderby on the same property."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "chat-id-123"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams chat.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Chat ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the chat you want to pull messages from. Use the chat's ID from Teams or a previous list-chats step so we know which conversation to read."
    },
    "orderby": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orderby",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "lastModifiedDateTime desc"
      ],
      "description": "OData v4.0 orderby expression for sorting messages. Only supports 'lastModifiedDateTime desc' and 'createdDateTime desc'. Ascending order is not supported. Required when using filter parameter - must be on the same property as the filter.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Order By",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional sort order for messages. Only supports 'lastModifiedDateTime desc' or 'createdDateTime desc'. Required when using filter to ensure the filter is applied."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "default": "me",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "user@example.com",
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The ID or user principal name (UPN) of the user whose chats are to be accessed. Use 'me' to specify the currently authenticated user.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The email address or identifier of the user whose chat messages you want to access. Use 'me' for your own messages."
    }
  }
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLEAR_PRESENCE
Tool to clear the presence information for a user's application presence session in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to remove presence information set by an application for the authenticated user. Note: This action can only clear presence for the authenticated user, not for other users.

```json
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ClearPresenceRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "sessionId"
  ],

      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose presence session to clear. Must be an explicit user ID (not 'me'). Note: You can only clear presence for the authenticated user - attempting to clear presence for other users will result in a 401 Unauthorized error. Use the user's object ID from Azure AD."
    },
    "sessionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session Id",
      "examples": [
        "9841f176-c6b4-4864-97ff-e88d245b2dbb"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the application's presence session to clear. This must exactly match the application ID (client ID) used for authentication. The API will return a 400 error if the sessionId doesn't match. This parameter is required."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for clearing a user's application presence session in Microsoft Teams."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CLONE_TEAM
Tool to clone a Microsoft Teams team using the team ID. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing team including its structure, channels, and tabs. This is an asynchronous operation; poll the returned location URL to monitor progress.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CloneTeamRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "displayName",
    "mailNickname"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team to clone."
    },
    "visibility": {
      "enum": [
        "private",
        "public",
        "hiddenMembership",
        "unknownFutureValue"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TeamVisibility",
      "examples": [
        "private",
        "public"
      ],
      "description": "Visibility type for the cloned team."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Test clone for API verification",
        "Backup copy of marketing team"
      ],
      "description": "An optional description for the cloned team. If not provided, it takes the value of displayName."
    },
    "displayName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Cloned Test Team API Verification",
        "Marketing Team - Copy"
      ],
      "description": "The display name for the cloned team. This property is required when a team is cloned."
    },
    "mailNickname": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mail Nickname",

        "settings,channels"
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_CHANNEL
Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to create a new channel for team collaboration.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Project Alpha Discussion",
        "Q4 Planning"
      ],
      "description": "The display name for the new channel. Maximum length is 50 characters. Cannot contain the following characters: ~ # % & * { } + / \\ : < > ? | ' \" , or control characters. Cannot start with an underscore (_) or period (.)",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want to call the new channel. Keep it short and clear so teammates can recognize it."
    },
    "members": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Members",
      "examples": [
        "[{\"@odata.type\": \"#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember\", \"user@odata.bind\": \"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('user-id-or-upn')\", \"roles\": [\"owner\"]}]"
      ],
      "description": "JSON string containing array of conversationMember objects to add as owners/members when creating private or shared channels. Each member object should include '@odata.type' (e.g., '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember'), 'user@odata.bind' (user URL), and 'roles' array (e.g., ['owner']). Required for private and shared channels to specify at least one owner. Maximum 200 members for private channels. For shared channels, only one owner can be added initially.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Initial Members",
      "human_parameter_description": "List of users to add as owners or members when creating a private or shared channel. Required for private/shared channels. Each entry needs the user's ID or email and their role. Provide as a JSON string."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F\\-]{36}$",
      "examples": [
        "e4e57af8-cff8-4557-af89-a43a6f961f32"
      ],
      "description": "The GUID of the existing Microsoft Teams team where the new channel will be created.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The Microsoft Teams team where you want to create the channel. Paste the team's ID (you can copy it from the team's settings or URL)."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "Channel for all discussions related to Project Alpha.",
        "Strategic planning for the fourth quarter."
      ],
      "description": "An optional, user-friendly description of the channel's purpose. Maximum length is 1024 characters.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "A brief summary of what this channel is for, so teammates know when to use it. This is optional."
    },
    "membership_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Membership Type",
      "default": "standard",
      "examples": [
        "standard",
        "private",
        "shared"
      ],
      "description": "Membership type determining channel accessibility: 'standard' is accessible to all team members, 'private' is only accessible to a specific subset of team members, and 'shared' can be shared with people outside the team or organization (requires appropriate policies).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Membership Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose who can access the channel: 'standard' for everyone on the team, 'private' for selected members, or 'shared' to collaborate with people outside the team. Pick the option that fits how widely you want the channel visible."
    },
    "created_date_time": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Created Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2020-03-14T11:22:17.067Z"
      ],
      "description": "The timestamp for when the channel was created. Only used when creating a channel in migration mode by including '@microsoft.graph.channelCreationMode': 'migration' in the request. Format: ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g., '2020-03-14T11:22:17.067Z').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Created Date Time",
      "human_parameter_description": "Custom creation timestamp for the channel. Only use this when importing historical data in migration mode."
    },
    "shared_with_teams": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Shared With Teams",
      "examples": [
        "[{\"id\": \"team-guid-here\"}]"
      ],
      "description": "JSON string containing array of team objects to share the channel with when creating a shared channel. Each object should contain an 'id' field with the team ID. Use this to share the channel with the host team or other teams.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Share With Teams",
      "human_parameter_description": "List of teams to share this channel with. Only applicable for shared channels. Each entry needs the team ID. Provide as a JSON string."
    },
    "is_favorite_by_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Favorite By Default",
      "description": "Indicates whether the channel should be marked as recommended for all members of the team to show in their channel list. Can only be set during creation. Defaults to false if not specified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Mark as Favorite",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to mark this channel as recommended for all team members. They'll see it highlighted in their channel list."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_GROUP_TEAM_CHANNEL
Tool to create a new channel in a group's associated team. Use when you have a group ID and need to create a channel in its team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateGroupTeamChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_id",
    "display_name"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "e4c36173-d019-45ec-9c77-497b86386206"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the group. This is the group ID, not the team ID. The group must have an associated team."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Channel for all discussions related to Project Alpha.",
        "Strategic planning for the fourth quarter."
      ],
      "description": "Optional textual description of the channel's purpose."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Project Alpha Discussion",
        "Q4 Planning",
        "General Updates"
      ],
      "maxLength": 50,
      "description": "The display name for the new channel. Maximum length is 50 characters. This is the only required field."
    },
    "membership_type": {
      "enum": [
        "standard",
        "private",
        "shared"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MembershipType",
      "description": "Channel membership type options."
    },
    "is_favorite_by_default": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Favorite By Default",
      "description": "Indicates whether the channel should be marked as recommended for all members of the team to show in their channel list. Can only be set during creation."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a channel in a group's team."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_MEETING
Use to schedule a new standalone Microsoft Teams online meeting, i.e., one not linked to any calendar event.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateMeetingRequest",
  "required": [
    "start_date_time",
    "end_date_time",
    "subject"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Project Sync-Up"
      ],
      "description": "The subject or title for the online meeting.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Meeting Subject",
      "human_parameter_description": "The title of your meeting. This is what attendees will see in the meeting invite and in Teams."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "description": "The user ID (object ID) on whose behalf to create the meeting. Required when using application permissions (S2S). If not specified, uses the /me endpoint (delegated permissions).",
      "human_parameter_name": "User ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the user who will be the organizer of the meeting. Required for service-to-service authentication."
    },
    "participants": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "OnlineMeetingParticipant",
        "required": [
          "user_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "role": {
            "enum": [
              "attendee",
              "presenter",
              "coorganizer"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Role",
            "default": "attendee",
            "description": "Specifies the role of the participant in the meeting. Defaults to 'attendee'. Allowed values are 'attendee', 'presenter', or 'coorganizer'."
          },
          "user_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "User Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams user to be added as a participant."
          }
        },
        "description": "Specifies a participant's identity (user ID) and role for a Microsoft Teams online meeting."
      },
      "title": "Participants",
      "description": "An optional list of participants to invite to the meeting. Each participant is defined by their user ID and role.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Participants",
      "human_parameter_description": "People you want to invite and their roles (attendee, presenter, or co-organizer). Add participants to send them an invite and set their permissions."
    },
    "end_date_time": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date Time",
      "format": "date-time",
      "examples": [
        "2024-08-15T11:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The end date and time of the meeting, specified in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-15T11:00:00Z'). Must be after start_date_time.",
      "human_parameter_name": "End Date Time",
      "human_parameter_description": "When your meeting should end. Pick a time after the start so the meeting runs for the right duration."
    },
    "allow_recording": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Recording",
      "description": "Indicates whether recording is enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "start_date_time": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date Time",
      "format": "date-time",
      "examples": [
        "2024-08-15T10:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The start date and time of the meeting, specified in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-08-15T10:00:00Z').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Start Date Time",
      "human_parameter_description": "When your meeting should start. Choose the exact date and time you want attendees to begin joining."
    },
    "allow_live_share": {
      "enum": [
        "enabled",
        "disabled"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MeetingLiveShareOptions",
      "description": "Indicates whether Live Share is enabled for the meeting. Possible values: enabled, disabled."
    },
    "allow_whiteboard": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Whiteboard",
      "description": "Indicates whether whiteboard is enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "allow_meeting_chat": {
      "enum": [
        "enabled",
        "disabled",
        "limited"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "MeetingChatMode",
      "description": "Specifies the mode of meeting chat. Possible values: enabled (default), disabled, limited (only during the meeting call)."
    },
    "allowed_presenters": {
      "enum": [
        "everyone",
        "organization",
        "roleIsPresenter",
        "organizer"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AllowedPresenters",
      "description": "Specifies who can be a presenter in a meeting. Possible values: everyone (default), organization, roleIsPresenter, organizer."
    },
    "allow_transcription": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Transcription",
      "description": "Indicates whether transcription is enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "meeting_template_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meeting Template Id",
      "description": "The ID of the meeting template. Using a custom meeting template to create a meeting is a Teams Premium feature."
    },
    "allow_breakout_rooms": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Breakout Rooms",
      "description": "Indicates whether breakout rooms are enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "is_passcode_required": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Passcode Required",
      "description": "An optional boolean indicating whether a passcode should be required to join this meeting. If not specified, the organization's default policy applies.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Passcode Required",
      "human_parameter_description": "Require a passcode for people to join the meeting. Turn this on for an extra layer of security."
    },
    "record_automatically": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Record Automatically",
      "description": "Indicates whether to record the meeting automatically."
    },
    "lobby_bypass_settings": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "LobbyBypassSettingsInput",
      "properties": {
        "scope": {
          "enum": [
            "organizer",
            "organization",
            "organizationAndFederated",
            "everyone",
            "invited",
            "organizationExcludingGuests"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "LobbyBypassScope",
          "description": "Specifies the type of participants that are automatically admitted into a meeting, bypassing the lobby."
        },
        "is_dialin_bypass_enabled": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Is Dialin Bypass Enabled",
          "description": "Specifies whether or not to always let dial-in callers bypass the lobby."
        }
      },
      "description": "Specifies which participants can bypass the meeting lobby.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "is_entry_exit_announced": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Entry Exit Announced",
      "description": "Indicates whether to announce when callers join or leave."
    },
    "allow_teamwork_reactions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Teamwork Reactions",
      "description": "Indicates whether Teams reactions are enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "allow_power_point_sharing": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Power Point Sharing",
      "description": "Indicates whether PowerPoint live is enabled for the meeting."
    },
    "allow_attendee_to_enable_mic": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Attendee To Enable Mic",
      "description": "Indicates whether attendees can unmute themselves."
    },
    "allow_attendee_to_enable_camera": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Attendee To Enable Camera",
      "description": "Indicates whether attendees can turn on their camera."
    },
    "is_end_to_end_encryption_enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is End To End Encryption Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether end-to-end encryption is enabled for the meeting. Note: This property must be used with Teams policies to determine the final behavior."
    },
    "allow_participants_to_change_name": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Participants To Change Name",
      "description": "Specifies whether participants are allowed to rename themselves in an instance of the meeting."
    },
    "share_meeting_chat_history_default": {
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "none"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ShareMeetingChatHistoryDefault",
      "description": "Specifies whether meeting chat history is shared with participants. Possible values: all, none."
    },
    "allow_copying_and_sharing_meeting_content": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Allow Copying And Sharing Meeting Content",
      "description": "Indicates whether participants can copy and share meeting content."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a new Microsoft Teams online meeting."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_OFFER_SHIFT_REQUEST
Tool to create a new offer shift request in a user's joined team schedule. Use when a team member wants to offer their shift to another team member.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateOfferShiftRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "senderShiftId",
    "recipientUserId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Optional user identifier. Not used in the API request as the endpoint operates at the team level. Accepts 'me' or a GUID/UUID format."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "#microsoft.graph.offerShiftRequest",
      "title": "Odata Type",
      "default": "#microsoft.graph.offerShiftRequest",
      "description": "The OData type of the resource. Must be '#microsoft.graph.offerShiftRequest'."
    },
    "senderMessage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Message",
      "examples": [
        "Would you like to take this shift?",
        "Can you cover my shift on Friday?"
      ],
      "description": "Optional message from the sender to the recipient explaining the shift offer."
    },
    "senderShiftId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender Shift Id",
      "examples": [
        "SHFT_67bbbd0f-ad83-46a1-a94f-fe9d9f29fb84"
      ],
      "description": "The shift ID that is being offered. Format typically starts with 'SHFT_' followed by a GUID."
    },
    "recipientUserId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recipient User Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "33ba30b9-9158-426d-a893-c3eff9d9a6bb"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID of the recipient to whom the shift is being offered. Must be a valid GUID/UUID."
    },
    "recipientActionMessage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recipient Action Message",
      "description": "Message from the recipient when responding to the offer. This is typically set when the recipient accepts or declines."
    },
    "recipientActionDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Recipient Action Date Time",
      "description": "Date and time when the recipient responded to the offer, in ISO 8601 format. This is typically set by the system."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating an offer shift request in a user's joined team schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_OPEN_SHIFT
Tool to create a new open shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to publish available shifts that team members can claim.

**Input schema:**

```json
                "title": "Start Date Time",
                "description": "Start time of the activity in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-03-01T12:00:00Z')."
              }
            },

          },

          "title": "End Date Time",

          ],

        },

          "title": "Open Slot Count",
          "examples": [

            2,
            3
          ],
          "description": "Number of open slots available for this shift. Indicates how many team members can claim this shift."
        },
        "startDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2026-02-25T18:00:00Z",
            "2026-03-01T08:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "Start time of the open shift in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-25T18:00:00Z')."
        }
      },
      "description": "The shared version of the open shift that is visible to team members. This contains the shift details including start/end times, theme, and open slot count.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "schedulingGroupId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scheduling Group Id",
      "examples": [

      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the scheduling group this open shift belongs to. Use format 'TAG_{guid}' for scheduling group IDs."
    },
    "isStagedForDeletion": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Staged For Deletion",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Indicates whether the open shift is staged for deletion. Set to true to mark for deletion."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to create a new open shift in a team schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_OPEN_SHIFT_CHANGE_REQUEST
Tool to create a new open shift change request in a team schedule. Use when a team member wants to claim an available open shift.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateOpenShiftChangeRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "openShiftId",
    "senderUserId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message",
      "description": "Optional message from the user explaining why they want to claim this open shift."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team (GUID format)."
    },
    "openShiftId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Open Shift Id",
      "examples": [
        "OPNSHFT_ca2655aa-2fc8-45dc-8c94-a6fcfc8924f0"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the open shift that the user is requesting to claim. This ID references an existing open shift in the team's schedule."
    },
    "senderUserId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender User Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "3fe0bc21-1398-4fd9-9713-52511b434c1e"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user who is requesting to claim the open shift."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to create a new open shift change request in a team schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_OR_GET_ONLINE_MEETING
Tool to create a new Microsoft Teams online meeting or retrieve an existing one based on externalId. Use when you need an idempotent meeting creation operation that returns an existing meeting if the externalId matches.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateOrGetOnlineMeetingRequest",
  "required": [
    "externalId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "user@contoso.com",
        "484453b2-158e-479b-9200-07bdb8a3cd12"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID (UPN or GUID) on whose behalf to create the meeting. Required for Service-to-Service (client credentials) authentication. If not provided, uses /me endpoint (delegated permissions only)."
    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Test Meeting via API",
        "Weekly Team Sync",
        "Client Presentation"
      ],
      "description": "The subject or title for the online meeting. Optional."
    },
    "chatInfo": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ChatInfo",
      "properties": {
        "threadId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Thread Id",
          "description": "The unique identifier for a thread in Microsoft Teams."
        },
        "messageId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message Id",
          "description": "The unique identifier of a message in a Microsoft Teams channel."
        },
        "@odata.type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Type",
          "default": "#microsoft.graph.chatInfo",
          "description": "OData type identifier for chatInfo."
        },
        "replyChainMessageId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Reply Chain Message Id",
          "description": "The ID of the reply message."
        }
      },
      "description": "The chat information associated with an online meeting.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "externalId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "External Id",
      "examples": [
        "test-meeting-12345",
        "project-sync-2026-02-24"
      ],
      "description": "The external ID that uniquely identifies this meeting. Required. If a meeting with this externalId already exists, that meeting is returned; otherwise, a new meeting is created. Maximum length is 256 characters."
    },
    "endDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-24T11:00:00Z",
        "2026-03-01T15:30:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The meeting end date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-24T11:00:00Z'). Optional but recommended. Should be after startDateTime if both are provided."
    },
    "participants": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MeetingParticipants",
      "properties": {
        "attendees": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "MeetingParticipantInfo",
            "properties": {
              "upn": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Upn",
                "description": "User principal name of the participant."
              },
              "role": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Role",
                "description": "Specifies the participant's role in the meeting. Possible values: attendee, presenter, unknownFutureValue."
              }
            },
            "description": "Information about a meeting participant (organizer or attendee)."
          },
          "title": "Attendees",
          "description": "Information about the meeting attendees."
        },
        "organizer": {
          "type": "object",
          "title": "MeetingParticipantInfo",
          "properties": {
            "upn": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Upn",
              "description": "User principal name of the participant."
            },
            "role": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Role",
              "description": "Specifies the participant's role in the meeting. Possible values: attendee, presenter, unknownFutureValue."
            }
          },
          "description": "Information about a meeting participant (organizer or attendee).",
          "additionalProperties": false
        },
        "@odata.type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Type",
          "default": "#microsoft.graph.meetingParticipants",
          "description": "OData type identifier for meetingParticipants."
        }
      },
      "description": "The participants associated with the online meeting.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "startDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-24T10:00:00Z",
        "2026-03-01T14:30:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The meeting start date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-24T10:00:00Z'). Optional but recommended."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating or retrieving a Microsoft Teams online meeting."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_SCHEDULE
Tool to create or replace a schedule object for a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to enable or configure scheduling features for a team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateOrUpdateScheduleRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether the schedule is enabled for the team. Set to true to enable."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F\\-]{36}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team (GUID format)."
    },
    "timeZone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Zone",
      "examples": [
        "America/New_York",
        "UTC",
        "Europe/London"
      ],
      "description": "Time zone for the schedule (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'UTC'). Uses IANA time zone identifiers."
    },
    "timeClockEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Time Clock Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether the time clock feature is enabled for the schedule."
    },
    "openShiftsEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open Shifts Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether open shifts are enabled for the schedule."
    },
    "timeOffRequestsEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Time Off Requests Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether team members can request time off."
    },
    "offerShiftRequestsEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Offer Shift Requests Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether team members can offer their shifts to others."
    },
    "swapShiftsRequestsEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Swap Shifts Requests Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether team members can swap shifts with each other."
    },
    "isActivitiesIncludedWhenCopyingShiftsEnabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Activities Included When Copying Shifts Enabled",
      "description": "Indicates whether activities are included when copying shifts."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to create or replace a schedule in Microsoft Teams."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_SCHEDULE_DAY_NOTE
Tool to create a new day note in a team's schedule. Use when you need to add notes or reminders for a specific date in the team schedule. Day notes help communicate important information to team members for a particular day.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateScheduleDayNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "dayNoteDate"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "26baab0a-c4eb-4e23-94ae-ac8b5304027d"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team where the day note will be created."
    },
    "dayNoteDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Day Note Date",
      "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-24",
        "2026-03-15"
      ],
      "description": "The date for which the day note applies, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-24')."
    },
    "draftDayNote": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "Team meeting at 2 PM",
            "Remember to complete timesheets"
          ],
          "description": "The actual content of the day note in plain text format."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "text",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "text"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the content. Only 'text' is supported for day notes (html is not supported by the Microsoft Teams API)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the content and format of a day note.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "sharedDayNote": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "Team meeting at 2 PM",
            "Remember to complete timesheets"
          ],
          "description": "The actual content of the day note in plain text format."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "text",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "text"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the content. Only 'text' is supported for day notes (html is not supported by the Microsoft Teams API)."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the content and format of a day note.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to create a new day note in a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_SCHEDULING_GROUP
Tool to create a new scheduling group in a team's schedule. Use when you need to organize team members into groups for shift scheduling and management. This action uses 'team_id' parameter naming which aligns with the Microsoft Graph API endpoint (/teams/{id}/schedule/schedulingGroups).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateSchedulingGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "display_name",
    "user_ids"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "examples": [
        "MORNING-1",
        "TSG001",
        "WE-TEAM"
      ],
      "description": "Code or identifier for the scheduling group. This can be used for external system integration or quick reference."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "user_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "User Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "550ac91a-5895-4c98-af68-e97197a65af4"
        ],
        []
      ],
      "description": "List of user IDs to include as members of this scheduling group. Each ID should be a valid GUID/UUID. Can be an empty array if no members are being added initially."
    },
    "is_active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Indicates whether the scheduling group is active and available for scheduling. Set to true to enable, false to disable."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Morning Shift",
        "Weekend Team",
        "Test Scheduling Group"
      ],
      "description": "Display name of the scheduling group. This is the name that will appear when managing schedules and shifts."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a new scheduling group in a team's schedule."
}
```

Tool to create a new timeOff instance in a team's schedule. Use when you need to create approved time off for a team member (vacation, sick leave, etc.).

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_TIME_OFF_REQUEST
Tool to create a new time off request in a team's schedule. Use when a team member needs to request time off for vacation, sick leave, or other absences.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateTimeOffRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "startDateTime",
    "endDateTime",
    "timeOffReasonId",
    "senderUserId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "odata_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "#microsoft.graph.timeOffRequest",
      "title": "Odata Type",
      "default": "#microsoft.graph.timeOffRequest",
      "description": "The OData type of the resource. Must be '#microsoft.graph.timeOffRequest'."
    },
    "endDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-03-16T00:00:00Z",
        "2026-04-02T17:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "End date and time of the time off request in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-03-16T00:00:00Z'). This represents when the requested time off ends."
    },
    "senderUserId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sender User Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "484453b2-158e-479b-9200-07bdb8a3cd12"
      ],
      "description": "The user ID of the person who is creating the time off request. Must be a valid user GUID in the organization (e.g., '484453b2-158e-479b-9200-07bdb8a3cd12')."
    },
    "startDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z",
        "2026-04-01T08:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "Start date and time of the time off request in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z'). This represents when the requested time off begins."
    },
    "timeOffReasonId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Off Reason Id",
      "examples": [
        "TOR_31a5f3a6-e4ba-41d9-9823-8220839fd095"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the time off reason. This ID references a predefined reason in the team's schedule (e.g., vacation, sick leave). Format typically starts with 'TOR_' followed by a GUID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for creating a new time off request in a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_USER_ONLINE_MEETING
Tool to create a new Microsoft Teams online meeting for a specific user. Use when you need to create an online meeting on behalf of a user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "required": [

    "startDateTime",
    "endDateTime",
    "subject"

      "title": "External Id",
      "examples": [
        "project-meeting-001",
        "client-demo-2026"
      ],

    },
    "endDateTime": {
      "type": "string",

      ],

    },
    "startDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Start Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-24T14:30:00.0000000Z",
        "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The meeting start date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-02-24T14:30:00.0000000Z')."
    },
    "meetingTemplateId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Meeting Template Id",
      "description": "The ID of the meeting template. Using a custom meeting template to create a meeting is a Teams Premium feature."

}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_DELETE_CALL_OPERATION

**Input schema:**

```json
    "call_id",
    "comms_operation_id"

      "title": "Call Id",
      "examples": [
        "57dab8b1-894c-409a-b240-bd8beae78896"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the call."
    },
    "if_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "description": "ETag value for conditional deletion. Use this to ensure the operation hasn't changed since last retrieved."

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Comms Operation Id",
      "examples": [
        "0fe0623f-d628-42ed-b4bd-8ac290072cc5"

  "description": "Request payload to delete a navigation property operation for a communication call."
}
```

```json
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",

  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_DELETE_CHANNEL
Tool to delete a channel from a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to permanently remove a channel. Note that the General channel cannot be deleted.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "DeleteChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team that contains the channel. Must be a valid GUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "if_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "examples": [
        "W/\"JjAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAiJw==\""
      ],
      "description": "ETag value for conditional delete. Use this to ensure the channel hasn't been modified since it was last retrieved."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:72737dcaab464ad99ab3ffda590e1854@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel to delete. Can be in thread format (e.g., '19:72737dcaab464ad99ab3ffda590e1854@thread.tacv2')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for deleting a channel from a Microsoft Teams team."
}
```

```json
      ],

        },
        "status_code": {

          "description": "HTTP status code returned by the delete operation. 204 indicates successful deletion."

      },
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_DELETE_DAY_NOTE
Tool to delete a day note from a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to remove a day note from a specific date in the team schedule. The If-Match header with ETag value is required for deletion.

**Input schema:**

```json
    "day_note_id",
    "if_match"

      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team. Must be a valid GUID."
    },
    "if_match": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "If Match",
      "examples": [
        "\"e800eff0-0000-0400-0000-69930a1e0000\""
      ],
      "description": "ETag value for conditional delete (REQUIRED). Use this to ensure the day note hasn't been modified since it was retrieved. Obtain this value from a GET request to the day note."
    },
    "day_note_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Day Note Id",
      "examples": [
        "NOTE_940eab35-f133-47dc-becd-b345e6cea66c"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the dayNote to delete. Typically starts with 'NOTE_' prefix."

  },

}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHANNEL
Tool to get a specific channel in a team. Use after obtaining valid team and channel IDs to fetch channel details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",

  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "members",
        "tabs"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of relationships to expand and include in the response (e.g., 'members', 'tabs').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand Relationships",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which related entities to include inline in the response (e.g., members, tabs). Leave blank to not expand any relationships."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "id,displayName,description",
        "id,displayName,membershipType,webUrl"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response (e.g., 'id,displayName,description'). Empty string returns all default properties. Use to optimize performance by excluding expensive properties like 'email' and 'summary'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which channel properties to return (e.g., id,displayName,description). Leave blank for all default properties. Excluding 'email' and 'summary' improves performance."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "893075dd-2487-4122-925f-022c42e20265"

      "description": "The unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be a valid GUID (e.g., '893075dd-2487-4122-925f-022c42e20265').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the team that contains the channel you want to see. You can paste it from the team's link or use the ID returned by a prior team search."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "pattern": "^19:[^@]+@thread\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "19:561fbdbbfca848a484f0a6f00ce9dbbd@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel within the specified team. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:561fbdbbfca848a484f0a6f00ce9dbbd@thread.tacv2').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the specific channel within the team that you want details for. You can copy it from the channel's link or from a previous list-channels step."
    }
  },
  "description": "Parameters for retrieving a specific channel in a team."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_REPLY
Tool to retrieve a single reply to a message in a channel. Use when you need to get details of a specific reply message.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChannelMessageReplyRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id",
    "message_id",
    "reply_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "replies"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Expand related entities. Use to include additional related information in the response."
    },

      },

          "body",

          "createdDateTime"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned. If not specified, all properties are returned."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams team."
    },
    "reply_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply Id",
      "examples": [
        "1771240360006"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the reply message to retrieve."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:04e881b862664873b6e97eeeb6961e5e@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the channel within the team."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "1768309336891"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the channel message that contains the reply."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for retrieving a single reply to a channel message."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHAT
Tool to retrieve a single chat by ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific chat.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetChatRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "members"
        ],
        [
          "lastMessagePreview"
        ],
        [
          "members",
          "lastMessagePreview"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of related entities to expand in the response. Supported values: 'members' (includes all chat members), 'lastMessagePreview' (includes preview of the last message). Leave empty to return only basic chat properties."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:b8577894a63548969c5c92bb9c80c5e1@thread.v2",
        "19:8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5_877192bd-9183-47d3-a74c-8aa0426716cf@unq.gbl.spaces"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to retrieve. This is the chat's ID in the format '19:abc123def456@thread.v2' for group chats or '19:user1_user2@unq.gbl.spaces' for one-on-one chats."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHAT_LAST_MESSAGE_PREVIEW
DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHAT instead. Tool to get lastMessagePreview from a chat. Use when you need to see the preview of the most recent message in a specific chat.

```json

      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat. This is a composite ID formatted like '19:abc123def456@thread.v2' for group chats or meeting chats."

  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_FILES_FOLDER
Tool to get the files folder (DriveItem) metadata for a specific channel in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to access file storage information for a channel.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetFilesFolderRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,name,webUrl",
        "id,name,size,createdDateTime"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated, e.g., 'id,name,webUrl')."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams group/team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "pattern": "^19:[^@]+@thread\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "19:3442cabe1ce346538fec728d83abe8a5@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the channel within the specified team. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:3442cabe1ce346538fec728d83abe8a5@thread.tacv2')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving the files folder of a team channel."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_GROUP_TEAM_CHANNEL
DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_CHANNEL instead. Tool to get a specific channel from a group's team. Use when you have a group ID and channel ID to fetch channel details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetGroupTeamChannelRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "members",
        "tabs"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of relationships to expand and include in the response."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,displayName,description",
        "id,displayName,membershipType,webUrl"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response (e.g., 'id,displayName,description'). Leave empty to return all default properties."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the group. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "pattern": "^19:[^@]+@thread\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "19:04e881b862664873b6e97eeeb6961e5e@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel within the specified group's team. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:04e881b862664873b6e97eeeb6961e5e@thread.tacv2')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a specific channel from a group's team."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_GROUP_TEAM_OPERATION
Tool to retrieve the status of a Teams async operation using groupId and operationId. Use when you need to poll and track the progress of long-running operations like team creation or archiving for a Microsoft 365 group.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "title": "GetGroupTeamOperationRequest",
  "required": [
    "group_id",
    "operation_id"

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "error"
      ],
      "description": "OData $expand query parameter to include related entities inline. Comma-separated list of relationships."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,status,operationType"
      ],
      "description": "OData $select query parameter to specify which properties to include in the response. Comma-separated list of property names."
    },
    "group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the Microsoft 365 group."
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Operation Id",
      "examples": [
        "4f0aabe2-04cc-4357-8a15-44cd27fbcdf2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the teamsAsyncOperation. Obtained from the Location header of the async operation response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to retrieve the status of a Teams async operation from a group."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_MY_PROFILE
Tool to retrieve a user's profile (id/UPN/mail/displayName). Supports both delegated auth (use user_id='me') and application-only auth (specify user ID/UPN). Use when operations require user identity information (e.g., chat creation).

```json
  "properties": {
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,userPrincipalName,mail,displayName",

      ],

      ],
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_OFFER_SHIFT_REQUEST

**Input schema:**
```json
{

    "offer_shift_request_id"

    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
```

```json

      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
```

```json
        [
          "id",

          "startDateTime",
          "endDateTime",
          "joinWebUrl"
        ],
        [
```
