## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_OPEN_SHIFT
Tool to get a specific open shift from a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to retrieve details about a particular unassigned open shift by its ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetOpenShiftRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "openshift_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,schedulingGroupId,sharedOpenShift",
        "id,createdDateTime"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated, e.g., 'id,schedulingGroupId,sharedOpenShift')."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "openshift_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Openshift Id",
      "examples": [
        "OPNSHFT_36878d77-7319-4c0e-9071-28f1f6a231c0"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the open shift to retrieve. Typically in the format 'OPNSHFT_<guid>' (e.g., 'OPNSHFT_36878d77-7319-4c0e-9071-28f1f6a231c0')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a specific open shift in a team schedule."
}
```

        "shifts",
        "timesOff",
        "schedulingGroups"

      "examples": [
        "id,enabled,timeZone",
        "id,provisionStatus,timeClockEnabled"
      ],

    },

      "type": "string",

      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F\\-]{36}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team (GUID format). This is the team whose schedule you want to retrieve."
    }
  },

}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_SWAP_SHIFTS_CHANGE_REQUEST
Tool to get a specific swap shift change request from a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to retrieve details of a single swap shift change request by its ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetSwapShiftsChangeRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "swap_shifts_change_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,state,recipientActionDateTime",
        "id,recipientUserId,senderUserId"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated, e.g., 'id,state,recipientActionDateTime')."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "swap_shifts_change_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Swap Shifts Change Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "SREQ_99721bb2-ec50-4615-ac20-d22c3710f762"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the swap shift change request to retrieve. Must start with 'SREQ_' prefix (e.g., 'SREQ_99721bb2-ec50-4615-ac20-d22c3710f762')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a swap shift change request in a team schedule."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_TEAM_OPERATION
Tool to retrieve the status of a Teams async operation using teamId and operationId. Use when you need to poll and track the progress of long-running operations like team creation or archiving. Microsoft recommends waiting at least 30 seconds between polling requests.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTeamOperationRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "operation_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "dbd8de4f-5d47-48da-87f1-594bed003375"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team associated with the operation."
    },
    "operation_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Operation Id",
      "examples": [
        "3a6fdce1-c261-48bc-89de-1cfef658c0d5"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the teamsAsyncOperation. Obtained from the Location header of the async operation response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to retrieve the status of a Teams async operation."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_TEAMS_APP_DEFINITION
Tool to get an installed app in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific app installation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTeamsAppDefinitionRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "app_installation_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "teamsAppDefinition",
        "teamsApp,teamsAppDefinition"
      ],
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response. Supports 'teamsApp', 'teamsAppDefinition'."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,consentedPermissionSet",
        "id"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated, e.g., 'id,consentedPermissionSet')."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789abc')."
    },

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_TIME_OFF_REASON
Tool to get a specific time off reason from a team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve details about a time off reason including its display name, icon type, and active status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTimeOffReasonRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "time_off_reason_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "time_off_reason_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Off Reason Id",
      "examples": [
        "TOR_891045ca-b5d2-406b-aa06-a3c8921245d7"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the time off reason to retrieve. This is the ID of the timeOffReason resource in the team's schedule (typically starts with 'TOR_' followed by a GUID)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for retrieving a time off reason from a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_TIME_OFF_REQUEST
Tool to retrieve a specific time off request from a team's schedule. Use when you need to check the status or details of a time off request.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetTimeOffRequestRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "time_off_request_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "time_off_request_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Off Request Id",
      "examples": [
        "SREQ_0782ff6b-0252-434f-86f3-6bd2d70cd5ae"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the time off request to retrieve. Format typically starts with 'SREQ_' followed by a GUID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for getting a time off request from a team's schedule."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_GET_USER_CHAT
Tool to retrieve a specific chat for a user. Use when you need to get details about a chat that a specific user is part of.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "GetUserChatRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "chat_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "members"
        ],
        [
          "lastMessagePreview"
        ],
        [
          "members",
          "lastMessagePreview"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Expand related entities. Supported values: 'members' (includes all chat members), 'lastMessagePreview' (includes preview of the last message)."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        [
          "id",
          "topic",
          "chatType"
        ],
        [
          "id",
          "createdDateTime",
          "webUrl"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Select properties to be returned. Specify which properties to include in the response to optimize the query."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:faa4b91d49684e4280a96824f5c4dc2e@thread.v2",
        "19:8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5_877192bd-9183-47d3-a74c-8aa0426716cf@unq.gbl.spaces"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to retrieve. This is the chat's ID in the format '19:abc123def456@thread.v2' for group chats or '19:user1_user2@unq.gbl.spaces' for one-on-one chats."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f",
        "user@contoso.com"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the user. Can be the user's UPN (user principal name) or the user's object ID (GUID)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for getting a specific chat for a user."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_HIDE_CHAT_FOR_USER
Tool to hide a Microsoft Teams chat for a specific user. Use when you need to hide a chat from a user's chat list. Note: The chat is automatically unhidden if an action such as sending a message is taken at the chat level.

**Input schema:**
```json

    "chat_id",
    "user"

        "tenantId"

          "examples": [

          ],
          "description": "The unique identifier of the user for whom to hide the chat."

        "tenantId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tenant Id",
          "examples": [
            "2a690434-97d9-4eed-83a6-f5f13600199a"
          ],
          "description": "The Azure AD tenant ID of the user. Required for hiding the chat."
        }
      },
      "description": "User identity containing the user ID and tenant ID. In delegated mode, users can only hide a chat for themselves.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:7d898072-792c-4006-bb10-5ca9f2590649_8ea0e38b-efb3-4757-924a-5f94061cf8c2@unq.gbl.spaces"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to hide."
    }
  },

}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_MESSAGE_REPLIES
Tool to list all replies to a specific message in a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to retrieve the conversation thread for a particular message.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListMessageRepliesRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50,
        20
      ],
      "description": "Show only the first n items. Useful for pagination and limiting result size."
    },
    "skip": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Skip",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Skip the first n items. Used for pagination to retrieve items beyond the initial set."
    },
    "count": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Count",
      "description": "Include count of items in the response. When true, adds a total count of matching replies."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "replies"
      ],
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "description": "Filter items by property values using OData syntax. Example: \"messageType eq 'message'\" or \"from/user/displayName eq 'John'\""
    },
    "search": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Search",
      "description": "Search items by search phrases. Use this to find replies containing specific keywords or phrases."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,body,from,createdDateTime",
        "id,subject,webUrl"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated). Example: 'id,body,from,createdDateTime'"
    },
    "orderby": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orderby",
      "examples": [
        "createdDateTime desc",
        "lastModifiedDateTime"
      ],
      "description": "Order items by property values. Example: 'createdDateTime desc' or 'lastModifiedDateTime'"
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:04e881b862664873b6e97eeeb6961e5e@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the channel within the team."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "1768309336891"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the parent message for which to retrieve replies."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for listing replies to a message in a Microsoft Teams channel."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_ONLINE_MEETINGS
Tool to list online meetings for a specific user in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to retrieve meetings for a user. NOTE: With delegated permissions, a filter parameter is typically required (e.g., by JoinWebUrl or joinMeetingId).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListOnlineMeetingsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "maximum": 999,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50
      ],
      "description": "Show only the first n items. Maximum value is 999."
    },
    "skip": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Skip",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Skip the first n items for pagination."
    },
    "count": {

      "description": "Include count of items in the response."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "examples": [
        "JoinWebUrl eq 'https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/...'"
      ],
      "description": "Filter items by property values using OData query syntax. REQUIRED with application (S2S/client_credentials) permissions \u2014 the API returns 'Filter expression expected' without it. The only supported filter property with application permissions is JoinWebUrl, e.g. \"JoinWebUrl eq 'https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/...' \". With delegated permissions, joinMeetingId may also work as a filter."

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_OPEN_SHIFT_CHANGE_REQUESTS
Tool to list open shift change requests in a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all open shift requests for a team's schedule.

**Input schema:**
```json

      "title": "Skip",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Skip the first n items for pagination."
    },

      "title": "Count",
      "description": "Include count of items in the response."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional data in the response."
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "examples": [
        "state eq 'approved'",
        "state eq 'pending'"
      ],
      "description": "Filter items by property values using OData query syntax (e.g., 'state eq \"approved\"')."
    },
    "search": {

      "description": "Search items by search phrases. Use this to find open shift requests by keywords."
    },
    "select": {

      "title": "Select",
      "examples": [
        "id,state,openShiftId",
        "id,senderUserId,senderMessage"
      ],
      "description": "Select specific properties to be returned (comma-separated, e.g., 'id,state,openShiftId')."
    },
    "orderby": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orderby",
      "examples": [
        "createdDateTime",
        "createdDateTime desc"
      ],
      "description": "Order items by property values (e.g., 'createdDateTime' or 'createdDateTime desc')."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing open shift change requests in a team schedule."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_PEOPLE
Retrieves a list of people relevant to a specified user from Microsoft Graph, noting the `search` parameter is only effective if `user_id` is 'me'.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPeopleRequest",

        "25",

OData functions like startsWith, endsWith, and contains are NOT supported and will result in API errors. Supported filterable properties include: displayName, personType/class, personType/subclass. ## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_PINNED_MESSAGES
Tool to retrieve the list of pinned messages in a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to get all messages that have been pinned in a specific chat conversation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListPinnedMessagesRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "expand": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        [
          "message"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Expand related entities to include additional details. Use 'message' to retrieve the full message content along with pinned message info."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:faa4b91d49684e4280a96824f5c4dc2e@thread.v2",
        "19:meeting_MGQ4OGJkZTgtYzE0Mi00YjM2LTg5NTctM2Q5ZjEyYjhhYjM2@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams chat. Use the Get All Chats action to retrieve valid chat IDs."
    }
  }
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_SCHEDULE_DAY_NOTES
Tool to list all dayNotes from a team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all day notes or search/filter notes for specific dates in a team's schedule.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListScheduleDayNotesRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team. Must be a valid GUID."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for listing all dayNotes from a team's schedule.\n\nNote: The Microsoft Graph API v1.0 endpoint for listing dayNotes has limited query parameter support.\nMost OData query parameters ($filter, $orderby, $count, $skip, $search, $select, $expand) are not supported\nand will result in 400 Bad Request errors. Only the team_id parameter is required and supported."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_USER_JOINED_TEAMS
Tool to list the Teams that a specified user is a direct member of (joined teams). Use for access/membership audits when enumerating team members is access-restricted.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListUserJoinedTeamsRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "me",
        "john.doe@contoso.com",
        "87d349ed-44d7-43e1-9a83-5f2406dee5bd"
      ],
      "description": "User ID or user principal name (UPN) to query joined teams for. Use 'me' to query the authenticated user's joined teams."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for listing teams that a user has joined."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_USERS
Tool to list all users in the organization. Use when you need to retrieve directory users with filtering, pagination, and field selection.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListUsersRequest",
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "maximum": 999,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        50,
        200
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of users to return per page (1-999). Default is 100. For pagination beyond the first page, use the @odata.nextLink URL returned in the response. Note: Some tenants have restrictive page size policies that may reject explicit $top values. If such an error occurs, the request will be retried without $top.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how many users to return on one page. Use this to limit large result sets. For additional pages, use the @odata.nextLink URL from the response."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "manager"
      ],
      "description": "OData expand related entities (e.g., manager).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include related information for each user, like their manager, when you need extra context in the results."
    },
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "examples": [
        "startswith(displayName,'John')"
      ],

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_MARK_CHAT_READ_FOR_USER
Tool to mark a chat as read for a specific user in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to update the read status of a chat for a particular user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MarkChatReadForUserRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id",
    "user"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "User",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "tenantId"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Id",
          "examples": [
            "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
          ],
          "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user in Azure AD."
        },
        "tenantId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tenant Id",
          "examples": [
            "a6a55c5f-0747-4804-a166-2b5dfc9ace2a"
          ],
          "description": "The Azure AD tenant ID where the user belongs."
        }
      },
      "description": "The user for whom the chat should be marked as read. Must include both user ID and tenant ID.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:12f973dcc61b428aae3e1ab42adf199d@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to mark as read."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload for marking a chat as read for a specific user."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_PIN_MESSAGE
Tool to pin a message in a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to highlight an important message for quick access.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PinMessageRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id",
    "message_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:faa4b91d49684e4280a96824f5c4dc2e@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat where the message to be pinned is located."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "1771858324199",
        "1612289992105"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the message to pin. This is a numeric timestamp string (milliseconds since epoch) returned by the Microsoft Graph API when listing messages."
    }
  }
}
```

{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "PinMessageResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "PinMessageResponse",
      "required": [

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_POST_MESSAGE_REPLY
Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by `message_id`, within a specific `channel_id` of a given `team_id` in Microsoft Teams.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PostMessageReplyRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id",
    "message_id",
    "content"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "Acknowledged.",
        "Sure, I will look into this.",
        "<p>Thank you for the update!</p>"
      ],
      "description": "The body of the reply message. This can be plain text or HTML, as specified by the `content_type` field.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content",

    },
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Follow-up on the previous discussion"
      ],
      "description": "The subject of the reply message, in plaintext. Typically null for channel message replies.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Subject",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional subject line for the reply message (rarely used in channel replies)."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "fbe2bf47-16c8-47cf-b4a5-4b9b187c508b"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team that owns/hosts the channel. IMPORTANT: For shared channels, this must be the host team ID (the team that created the channel), not the team where you access the shared channel. If you receive a 404 'Channel does not belong to Team' error, you likely need to use the host team's ID instead.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the Microsoft Teams team that owns/hosts the channel with the message you're replying to. For shared channels, use the host team's ID, not the team where you access the shared channel."

                "userIdentityType": "aadUser"

            },
            "mentionText": "John Doe"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of entities (users, bots, teams, channels) mentioned in the reply. Each mention should include 'id' (numeric index), 'mentionText', and 'mentioned' (entity details). The 'id' corresponds to the 'id' attribute in HTML <at> tags in the message content.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Mentions",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional list of @mentions to include in the reply. Used to notify specific users or teams."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",

        "19:c2fd609a5db440179d7400e0a8ac9ac2@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel containing the message to reply to. Standard channels use format '19:{alphanumeric}@thread.tacv2'. For shared/private channels, the format may differ (e.g., '19:{guid}@thread.tacv2' or '19:{id}@unq.gbl.spaces'). The channel must belong to the team specified in team_id.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the channel inside the team where the original message lives. Often starts with '19:'; you can copy it from the channel URL."
    },

      "type": "string",

      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the specific message within the channel to which this reply is directed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Message ID",

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_PROVISION_CHANNEL_EMAIL
Tool to provision an email address for a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to enable email integration for a specific channel.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ProvisionChannelEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the team that contains the channel."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "pattern": "^19:[^@]+@thread\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$",
      "examples": [
        "19:3442cabe1ce346538fec728d83abe8a5@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel within the team to provision an email address for."
    }
  }
}
```

        }
      }

  "required": [

    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "email": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Email",
          "description": "The provisioned email address for the channel."
        },
        "@odata.type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "@Odata.Type",
          "description": "OData type identifier for the response object."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"

    "error": {

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_REMOVE_CHANNEL_EMAIL
Tool to remove the email address of a channel in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to disable email integration for a specific channel.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveChannelEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the team that contains the channel. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",

      "examples": [
        "19:4889194729264b06aa92cadc3cbb8bf0@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the channel whose email address should be removed. Must be in thread format (e.g., '19:4889194729264b06aa92cadc3cbb8bf0@thread.tacv2')."
    }
  },

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_REMOVE_TEAM_MEMBERS
Tool to remove multiple members from a Microsoft Teams team in bulk. Use when you need to remove one or more users from a team.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RemoveTeamMembersRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "members"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "members": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "ConversationMemberInput",
        "required": [
          "user_id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "user_id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "User Id",
            "examples": [
              "18a80140-b0fb-4489-b360-2f6efaf225a0",
              "user@contoso.com"
            ],

          "@odata.type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "@Odata.Type",
            "default": "microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember",
            "description": "The OData type identifier for the conversation member. Should be 'microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember' for Azure AD users."
          }
        },
        "description": "Individual member to remove from the team."
      },
      "title": "Members",
      "maxItems": 20,
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "List of members to remove from the team. Maximum 20 members can be removed in a single request."

    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "e4183b04-c9a2-417c-bde4-70e3ee46a6dc"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team from which to remove members."
    }
  }
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SEARCH_FILES
Search files in Microsoft Teams using KQL syntax. Find files by name, type, content, author, and modification date across all Teams and channels. Supports boolean logic and date ranges. Examples: 'filetype:pdf AND lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01', 'contract AND budget', 'filename:report AND author:user@example.com'

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchTeamsFilesRequest",
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Size",
      "default": 25,
      "description": "The maximum number of file results to return per page. Use with from_index for pagination.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many results to show per page. Larger numbers display more files at once but can take a bit longer to load."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "contract",
        "filetype:pdf AND lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01",
        "(budget OR financial) AND filetype:xlsx",
        "filename:report AND author:manager@example.com",
        "lastmodifiedtime>today-30 AND filetype:docx"
      ],
      "description": "Search query for files in Teams. Supports keywords, filenames, and content search.\n\n**Basic Syntax:**\n- Keywords: 'budget contract'\n- Exact phrases: '\"project timeline\"'\n- Filenames: 'report.pdf' or 'filename:contract'\n- File types: 'filetype:pdf' or 'filetype:docx'\n- Boolean: 'contract AND budget' or 'report OR summary'\n\n**Property Filters:**\n- filename: File name - 'filename:contract'\n- filetype: File extension - 'filetype:pdf', 'filetype:docx', 'filetype:xlsx'\n- author: Creator - 'author:user@example.com'\n- lastmodifiedtime: Modified date - 'lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01'\n\n**Date Filters:**\n- Exact: 'lastmodifiedtime:2024-10-01'\n- Greater/equal: 'lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01'\n- Range: 'lastmodifiedtime:2024-10-01..2024-10-31'\n- Relative: 'lastmodifiedtime>today-30'\n\n**Complex Queries:**\n- 'contract AND filetype:pdf AND lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01'\n- '(budget OR financial) AND filetype:xlsx'\n- 'filename:report AND lastmodifiedtime>today-7'",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "What do you want to search for? Enter keywords, file names, or simple filters (like filetype:pdf) to find the files you need across your Teams."
    },
    "region": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Region",
      "description": "Specifies the geographic region for the search request. ONLY required when using application permissions (S2S authentication). DO NOT use with delegated permissions (user authentication) - the API will reject the request. Valid values: 'NAM' (North America), 'EMEA' (Europe, Middle East, Africa), 'APAC' (Asia Pacific). Leave unset (None) for delegated permissions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Region",
      "human_parameter_description": "Geographic region for search (only for application permissions). Leave empty for user authentication."
    },
    "from_index": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "From Index",
      "default": 0,
      "description": "The 0-based starting index for pagination. To paginate: check response['value'][0]['hitsContainers'][0]['moreResultsAvailable']. If true, call again with from_index += size (e.g., 0 \u2192 25 \u2192 50).",
      "human_parameter_name": "From Index",
      "human_parameter_description": "Where to start in the results list. Use 0 for the first page, then increase by the page size (e.g., 25, 50) to see the next pages."
    }
  },
  "description": "Searches files in Microsoft Teams using the Microsoft Search API."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SEARCH_MESSAGES
Search Microsoft Teams messages using powerful KQL syntax. Supports sender (from:), date filters (sent:), attachments, and boolean logic. Works across all Teams chats and channels the user has access to. Examples: 'from:user@example.com AND sent>=2024-10-01', 'punchlist OR termination', 'sent>today-30 AND hasattachment:yes' NOTE: This action requires an organizational Microsoft 365 account (Azure AD/Entra ID). It does NOT work with personal Microsoft accounts (MSA) such as @outlook.com, @hotmail.com, or @live.com. If using a personal Microsoft account, this search will fail.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchTeamsMessagesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Size",
      "default": 25,
      "description": "The maximum number of search results to return per page. Use with from_index for pagination.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Page Size",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many messages to return per page. Larger numbers show more at once but may take longer."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "project update",
        "from:manager@example.com AND sent>=2024-10-01",
        "(punchlist OR termination) AND sent:2024-10",
        "sent>today-30 AND hasattachment:yes",
        "contract AND sent:2024-10-01..2024-10-31"
      ],
      "description": "KQL (Keyword Query Language) search query string. Supports advanced syntax for precise searches.\n\n**Basic Syntax:**\n- Simple keywords: 'budget report'\n- Exact phrases: '\"quarterly review\"'\n- Boolean operators: 'urgent AND deadline' or 'invoice OR receipt'\n\n**Property Filters (prefix:value):**\n- from: Sender - 'from:user@example.com' or 'from:example.com'\n- sent: Date sent - 'sent:2024-10-01' or 'sent>=2024-10-01'\n- hasattachment: Has files - 'hasattachment:yes' or 'hasattachment:no'\n\n**Date Operators:**\n- Exact: 'sent:2024-10-01'\n- Greater/equal: 'sent>=2024-10-01'\n- Less/equal: 'sent<=2024-10-31'\n- Range: 'sent:2024-10-01..2024-10-31'\n- Relative: 'sent>today-7' (last 7 days)\n\n**Combining Filters:**\n- AND: 'from:user@example.com AND subject:budget'\n- OR: 'punchlist OR termination'\n- Complex: '(punchlist OR termination) AND sent>=2024-10-01'\n\nNote: A search query is required. To return recent messages without a keyword filter, use a date range like 'sent>=2020-01-01'. Empty queries will default to 'sent>=2020-01-01' to return recent messages.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type what you want to find in Teams. Use simple keywords or filters like from:someone and date ranges to narrow results."
    },
    "region": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Region",
      "description": "Specifies the geographic region for the search request. ONLY required when using application permissions (S2S authentication). DO NOT use with delegated permissions (user authentication) - the API will reject the request. Valid values: 'NAM' (North America), 'EMEA' (Europe, Middle East, Africa), 'APAC' (Asia Pacific). Leave unset (None) for delegated permissions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Region",
      "human_parameter_description": "Geographic region for search (only for application permissions). Leave empty for user authentication."
    },
    "from_index": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "From Index",
      "default": 0,
      "description": "The 0-based starting index for pagination. To paginate: check response['value'][0]['hitsContainers'][0]['moreResultsAvailable']. If true, call again with from_index += size (e.g., 0 \u2192 25 \u2192 50). Message ID is in hits[]['hitId'], not hits[]['resource']['id'].",
      "human_parameter_name": "From Index",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose where to start in the results when paging. Use 0 for the first page, then add the page size to get the next page."
    },
    "enable_top_results": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enable Top Results",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If `true`, sorts results by relevance; otherwise, sorts by date in descending order (newest first).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Enable Top Results",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show the most relevant messages first instead of the newest. Turn this on when you want relevance over recency."
    }
  },
  "description": "Searches Microsoft Teams messages using the Microsoft Search API."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SEND_ACTIVITY_NOTIFICATION
Tool to send activity notifications to specified recipients in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to send custom notifications to users, team members, or channel members.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SendActivityNotificationRequest",
  "required": [
    "topic",
    "activityType",
    "previewText",
    "recipients"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "topic": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Topic",
      "required": [
        "source",
        "value"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Value",
          "examples": [
            "Test Notification",
            "New Task Assigned"
          ],
          "description": "The text value or description of the notification topic."
        },
        "source": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Source",
          "examples": [
            "text",
            "entityUrl"
          ],
          "description": "Source type of the notification topic. Common value is 'text'."
        },
        "webUrl": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Web Url",
          "examples": [
            "https://teams.microsoft.com/l/entity/com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.wiki/tab::00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
          ],
          "description": "URL for deep linking into Teams. Must use teams.microsoft.com domain with /l/ path pattern (e.g., teams.microsoft.com/l/entity/, /l/message/, /l/loopthread/)."
        }
      },
      "description": "The topic of the notification, including source, value, and optional webUrl for deep linking.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "chainId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Chain Id",
      "description": "Optional chain ID for grouping related notifications together."
    },
    "recipients": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "NotificationRecipient",
        "required": [
          "odata_type"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "teamId": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Team Id",
            "description": "The team ID. Required when odata_type is 'microsoft.graph.teamMembersNotificationRecipient'."
          },
          "userId": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "User Id",
            "examples": [
              "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
            ],
            "description": "The Azure AD user ID of the recipient. Required when odata_type is 'microsoft.graph.aadUserNotificationRecipient'."
          },
          "channelId": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Channel Id",
            "description": "The channel ID. Required when odata_type is 'microsoft.graph.channelMembersNotificationRecipient'."
          },
          "odata_type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Odata Type",
            "examples": [
              "microsoft.graph.aadUserNotificationRecipient",
              "microsoft.graph.teamMembersNotificationRecipient",
              "microsoft.graph.channelMembersNotificationRecipient"
            ],
            "description": "The type of recipient. Use 'microsoft.graph.aadUserNotificationRecipient' for Azure AD users."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a recipient of an activity notification."
      },
      "title": "Recipients",
      "description": "Array of recipients who will receive the notification. Each recipient must specify an @odata.type and corresponding ID fields."
    },
    "teamsAppId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Teams App Id",
      "description": "Optional Teams app ID if the notification is associated with a specific Teams app."
    },
    "previewText": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Preview Text",
      "required": [
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "This is a test notification",
            "You have a new task assigned"
          ],
          "description": "The preview text content to display in the notification."
        }
      },
      "description": "The preview text to display in the notification.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "activityType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity Type",
      "examples": [
        "testNotification",
        "taskAssigned",
        "approvalRequest"
      ],
      "description": "The type of activity being notified. This should match an activity type defined in the Teams app manifest."
    },
    "templateParameters": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "TemplateParameter",
        "required": [
          "name",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "taskName",
              "assignedTo"
            ],
            "description": "The name of the template parameter."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "Review Q4 Report",
              "John Doe"
            ],
            "description": "The value of the template parameter."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a key-value pair for template parameters."
      },
      "title": "Template Parameters",
      "description": "Optional array of template parameters as key-value pairs for customizing the notification content."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to send activity notifications to specified recipients in Microsoft Teams."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_ME_PREFERRED_PRESENCE
DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_USER_PREFERRED_PRESENCE instead. Tool to set the preferred availability and activity status for the current authenticated user. Use when you need to update your own presence status in Microsoft Teams. Preferred presence takes effect only when at least one presence session exists.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetMePreferredPresenceRequest",
  "required": [
    "availability",
    "activity"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "activity": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb",
        "BeRightBack",
        "Away",
        "OffWork"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb"
      ],
      "description": "The supplemental information to availability. Must match the availability value for valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/Busy, DoNotDisturb/DoNotDisturb, BeRightBack/BeRightBack, Away/Away, or Offline/OffWork."
    },
    "availability": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb",
        "BeRightBack",
        "Away",
        "Offline"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Availability",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb"
      ],
      "description": "The base presence information. Must match the activity value for valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/Busy, DoNotDisturb/DoNotDisturb, BeRightBack/BeRightBack, Away/Away, or Offline/OffWork."
    },
    "expiration_duration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expiration Duration",
      "examples": [
        "PT8H",
        "P1D",
        "PT30M"
      ],
      "description": "The expiration of the app presence session in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., 'PT8H' for 8 hours). If not provided, default expiration applies: DoNotDisturb or Busy expire in 1 day, all others expire in 7 days."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for setting the current user's preferred presence."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_PRESENCE
Tool to set the presence information for a user's application presence session. Use when you need to update a user's presence state in Microsoft Teams. Valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/InACall, Busy/InAConferenceCall, Away/Away, or DoNotDisturb/Presenting.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetPresenceRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "session_id",
    "availability",
    "activity"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa8bf3dc-eca7-46b7-bad1-db199b62afc3"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose presence session to set."
    },
    "activity": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "InACall",
        "InAConferenceCall",
        "Away",
        "Presenting"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "InACall",
        "Presenting"
      ],
      "description": "The supplemental information to availability. Must match valid combinations with availability."
    },
    "session_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Session Id",
      "examples": [
        "9841f176-c6b4-4864-97ff-e88d245b2dbb"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the application's presence session. This should typically match the application ID (appId) from the OAuth token."
    },
    "availability": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "Away",
        "DoNotDisturb"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Availability",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "Away"
      ],
      "description": "The base presence information. Valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/InACall, Busy/InAConferenceCall, Away/Away, DoNotDisturb/Presenting."
    },
    "expiration_duration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expiration Duration",
      "pattern": "^-?P([0-9]+D)?(T([0-9]+H)?([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?S)?)?$",
      "examples": [
        "PT1H",
        "PT30M",
        "PT4H"
      ],
      "description": "The expiration of the app presence session in ISO 8601 duration format. Valid range is PT5M to PT4H (5 minutes to 4 hours). If not provided, defaults to 5 minutes."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for setting presence in Microsoft Teams."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "SetPresenceResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SetPresenceResponse",
      "properties": {
        "message": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Message",
          "default": "Presence set successfully.",

        }

    }

  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",

          "type": "string",

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_PRESENCE_AUTOMATIC_LOCATION
Tool to set the automatic presence location (office/remote/timeOff) for a specified user. Use when updating work location status in Microsoft Teams via automatic detection.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetPresenceAutomaticLocationRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "workLocationType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "placeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Place Id",
      "description": "Optional identifier of the place associated with the work location. This can be a GUID or other identifier representing a physical location."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose automatic presence location will be set."
    },
    "workLocationType": {
      "enum": [
        "unspecified",
        "office",
        "remote",
        "timeOff",
        "unknownFutureValue"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Work Location Type",
      "examples": [
        "remote",
        "office",
        "timeOff"
      ],
      "description": "The work location type to set for the user's automatic presence. Choose 'office' if working from office, 'remote' if working remotely, 'timeOff' if on time off, or 'unspecified' to clear the location."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload for setting the automatic presence location for a user."
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_USER_PREFERRED_PRESENCE
Tool to set the preferred availability and activity status for a user. Use when you need to update a user's presence status in Microsoft Teams. Preferred presence takes effect only when at least one presence session exists for the user.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetUserPreferredPresenceRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "availability",
    "activity"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "fa8bf3dc-eca7-46b7-bad1-db199b62afc3"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user whose preferred presence status will be set."
    },
    "activity": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb",
        "BeRightBack",
        "Away",
        "OffWork"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Activity",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb"
      ],
      "description": "The supplemental information to availability. Must match the availability value for valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/Busy, DoNotDisturb/DoNotDisturb, BeRightBack/BeRightBack, Away/Away, or Offline/OffWork."
    },
    "availability": {
      "enum": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb",
        "BeRightBack",
        "Away",
        "Offline"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Availability",
      "examples": [
        "Available",
        "Busy",
        "DoNotDisturb"
      ],
      "description": "The base presence information. Must match the activity value for valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/Busy, DoNotDisturb/DoNotDisturb, BeRightBack/BeRightBack, Away/Away, or Offline/OffWork."
    },
    "expiration_duration": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expiration Duration",
      "pattern": "^-?P([0-9]+D)?(T([0-9]+H)?([0-9]+M)?([0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?S)?)?$",
      "examples": [
        "PT8H",
        "P1D",
        "PT30M"
      ],
      "description": "The expiration of the app presence session in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., 'PT8H' for 8 hours). If not provided, default expiration applies: DoNotDisturb or Busy expire in 1 day, all others expire in 7 days."
    }
  }
}
```

**Input schema:**

        false

      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to get the total number of teams in the response. This count appears in the first page only."
    },

      "title": "Filter",
      "default": "",

    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "id,displayName",
        "description,visibility"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated team properties to retrieve (e.g., 'id,displayName,description'). If empty or omitted, standard properties are returned. Supported properties include `id`, `displayName`, `description`, `visibility`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team Properties",

  }
}

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAMS_LIST_CHANNEL_MESSAGES
Tool to list messages in a Teams channel when team_id and channel_id are known (no chat_id required). Use this to enumerate channel message history and obtain message_id for follow-on operations like listing replies or getting message details.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListChannelMessagesRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "channel_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "top": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Top",
      "default": 50,
      "maximum": 50,
      "minimum": 1,
      "examples": [
        20,
        50
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of messages to return per page (1-50). Microsoft Graph enforces a maximum of 50 messages per request.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Top Count",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many messages to retrieve in one batch (maximum 50). Choose a smaller number for faster results."
    },
    "expand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Expand",
      "examples": [
        "replies"
      ],
      "description": "Optional expansion parameter. Only 'replies' is supported, which includes message replies (up to 1,000 per message; use replies@odata.nextLink for more).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Expand",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to 'replies' to include reply threads with each message. Leave empty to only get top-level messages."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "fbe2bf47-16c8-47cf-b4a5-4b9b187c508b"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the team that contains the channel. Use the team ID from a previous step or from your Teams admin view."
    },
    "channel_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Channel Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:4a95f7d8db4c4e7fae857bcebe0623e6@thread.tacv2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the channel within the team.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Channel ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific channel in that team whose message history you want to retrieve. Provide the channel's ID so we know which channel to list messages from."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for listing messages in a Teams channel."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAMS_LIST_CHANNELS
Retrieves channels for a specified Microsoft Teams team ID (must be valid and for an existing team), with options to include shared channels, filter results, and select properties.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListChannelsRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "filter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Filter",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "startswith(displayName,'Sales')",
        "membershipType eq 'private'"
      ],
      "description": "OData v4 query string to filter channels (e.g., `startswith(displayName,'Sales')` or `membershipType eq 'private'`).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add a simple filter to narrow the results (for example, names starting with 'Sales' or only private channels). Leave this empty to show all channels."
    },
    "select": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Select",
      "default": "",
      "examples": [
        "id,displayName,description"
      ],
      "description": "Comma-separated channel properties to return (e.g., 'id,displayName,description'); empty for default properties. Common: `id`, `displayName`, `description`, `email`, `membershipType`, `webUrl`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Select Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which channel details to return (for example: id, displayName, description). Leave this blank to use the default set of details."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707'). Team names are not accepted. Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_LIST_USER_JOINED_TEAMS to get team IDs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Team ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique GUID/UUID of the Microsoft Teams team whose channels you want to list. This must be a valid UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707'), not a team name. Use the List User Joined Teams action to get the team's ID."
    },
    "include_shared_channels": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Shared Channels",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, include channels shared with the team (uses allChannels endpoint). If false, exclude shared channels from results by filtering on membershipType.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Shared Channels",
      "human_parameter_description": "Include channels that are shared with this team from other teams. When enabled, uses the allChannels endpoint to show all channels including incoming shared channels. When disabled, filters out channels with membershipType 'shared' from the results."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAMS_LIST_CHAT_MESSAGES
DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead. Retrieves messages (newest first) from an existing and accessible Microsoft Teams one-on-one chat, group chat, or channel thread, specified by `chat_id`.

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAMS_POST_CHANNEL_MESSAGE
Posts a new top-level message to a channel in Microsoft Teams (does NOT reply to an existing message). Despite the file name 'reply_to_channel_chat', this action creates a brand-new message in the channel via POST /teams/{id}/channels/{id}/messages. To reply to an existing message thread, use the dedicated reply action instead.

**Input schema:**
```json

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_TEAMS_POST_CHAT_MESSAGE
Sends a non-empty message (text or HTML) to a specified, existing Microsoft Teams chat; content must be valid HTML if `content_type` is 'html'.

                    "type": "string",

                  },

                  },

                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Created Date Time",
                    "description": "The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC time."
                  },

                    "type": "string",
                    "title": "Reaction Content Url",
                    "description": "The hosted content URL for the custom reaction type."
                  }
                },
                "description": "The reaction in the modified message."
              },

                "type": "string",
                "title": "Modified Date Time",
                "description": "The date and time when the message was modified."
              }
            }
          },

          "description": "List of activity history of a message item, including modification time and actions, such as reactionAdded, reactionRemoved, or reaction changes, on the message."
        },

          "type": "object",
          "title": "Channel Identity",
          "properties": {
            "teamId": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Team Id",

            },
            "channelId": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Channel Id",
              "description": "The identity of the channel in which the message was posted."
            }
          },
          "description": "If the message was sent in a channel, represents identity of the channel."
        },
        "createdDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Created Date Time",
          "description": "Timestamp of when the chat message was created."
        },
        "deletedDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Deleted Date Time",
          "description": "Timestamp at which the chat message was deleted, or null if not deleted."
        },

          "type": "object",
          "title": "Policy Violation",
          "properties": {
            "dlpAction": {
              "type": "string",

                },
                "complianceUrl": {

                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Matched Condition Descriptions",

            },
            "userAction": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "User Action",

            },
            "verdictDetails": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Verdict Details",
              "description": "Indicates what actions the sender may take in response to the policy violation. Possible values are: None, AllowFalsePositiveOverride, AllowOverrideWithoutJustification, AllowOverrideWithJustification."
            },
            "justificationText": {
              "type": "string",
              "title": "Justification Text",

        },

          "type": "string",

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_CHAT
Tool to update the properties of a chat. Use when you need to modify chat settings such as the topic.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateChatRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "topic": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Topic",
      "examples": [
        "Project Alpha Discussion - Updated",
        "Team Standup Meeting"
      ],
      "description": "The new topic/title for the chat. Only applicable for group chats. For one-on-one chats, this property cannot be updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Topic",
      "human_parameter_description": "The new title for the chat. This only works for group chats; one-on-one chats don't have editable topics."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:faa4b91d49684e4280a96824f5c4dc2e@thread.v2",
        "19:meeting_abc123@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the chat to update. This can be obtained from the chat's URL or from other chat-related operations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Chat ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the chat you want to update. You can get this from the chat's details or URL."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to update properties of a Microsoft Teams chat."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "UpdateChatResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "UpdateChatResponse",
      "properties": {
        "display_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Url",
          "description": "Direct URL to view the updated chat in Microsoft Teams web interface."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response from updating a Microsoft Teams chat.\nReturns empty on success (204 No Content)."
    }
  },
  "title": "UpdateChatResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {
        "display_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Display Url",
          "description": "Direct URL to view the updated chat in Microsoft Teams web interface."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_CHAT_MESSAGE
Tool to update a specific message in a chat. Use when you need to correct or modify a sent chat message.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateChatMessageRequest",
  "required": [
    "chat_id",
    "message_id",
    "content"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Model",
      "examples": [
        "A"
      ],
      "description": "Query parameter for metered API usage. Set to 'A' to enable metered mode. If not specified, evaluation mode is used by default.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Model",
      "human_parameter_description": "Optional parameter to control API metering. Use 'A' for metered mode or leave empty for evaluation mode."
    },
    "chat_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Chat Id",
      "examples": [
        "19:meeting_NTg0NTQ2YjctMDJkNi00M2U3LWFkNmQtN2U4MDVmYjE0MDc5@thread.v2"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams chat.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Chat ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the chat where the message lives. Use the chat's ID from Teams or from an earlier search so we know which conversation to update."
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content",
      "examples": [
        "Updated the details of the meeting."
      ],
      "description": "Updated message content, either plain text or HTML.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want the message to say after the update. Type the new text (or HTML) that should replace the current message content."
    },
    "message_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message Id",
      "examples": [
        "1593478509446"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the chat message to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Message ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific message you want to change. Provide the message's ID from that chat, usually obtained from a previous list or search."
    },
    "content_type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Type",
      "default": "text",
      "examples": [
        "text",
        "html"
      ],
      "description": "Format of the message content: 'text' or 'html'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Tell us whether your new content is plain text or HTML. Choose 'text' for a simple message or 'html' if you're using formatting like bold or links."
    }
  }
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_DAY_NOTE
Tool to update an existing day note in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify notes or reminders for a specific date in the team schedule.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateDayNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "dayNote_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team containing the day note."
    },
    "dayNote_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Day Note Id",
      "examples": [
        "NOTE_5bae75cd-df22-4aa2-b5e1-e4f70b775630"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the dayNote to update. Typically starts with 'NOTE_' prefix."
    },
    "dayNoteDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Day Note Date",
      "pattern": "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-26",
        "2026-03-15"
      ],
      "description": "The date for which the day note applies, in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., '2026-02-26'). Provide only if updating the date."
    },
    "draftDayNote": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "Team meeting at 2 PM",
            "<p>Remember to complete timesheets</p>"
          ],
          "description": "The actual content of the day note. Can be plain text or HTML depending on contentType."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "enum": [
            "text",
            "html"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "text",
            "html"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the content. Accepted values are 'text' for plain text and 'html' for HTML-formatted content."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the content and format of a day note.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "sharedDayNote": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ItemBody",
      "required": [
        "contentType",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "examples": [
            "Team meeting at 2 PM",
            "<p>Remember to complete timesheets</p>"
          ],
          "description": "The actual content of the day note. Can be plain text or HTML depending on contentType."
        },
        "contentType": {
          "enum": [
            "text",
            "html"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content Type",
          "examples": [
            "text",
            "html"
          ],
          "description": "The format of the content. Accepted values are 'text' for plain text and 'html' for HTML-formatted content."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents the content and format of a day note.",
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload to update an existing day note in a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_ONLINE_MEETING
Tool to update the properties of an existing Microsoft Teams online meeting. Use when you need to modify meeting details such as subject, start time, or end time.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateOnlineMeetingRequest",
  "required": [
    "user_id",
    "online_meeting_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "subject": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subject",
      "examples": [
        "Updated Test Meeting",
        "Rescheduled Project Sync"
      ],
      "description": "The subject or title for the online meeting."
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (GUID) of the user who owns the online meeting."
    },
    "endDateTime": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "End Date Time",
      "examples": [
        "2026-02-24T11:00:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The meeting end date and time in ISO 8601 format. When updating date/time, both startDateTime and endDateTime are required."
    },
    "participants": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "MeetingParticipantsInput",
      "properties": {
        "attendees": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "MeetingParticipantInfo",
            "properties": {
              "upn": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Upn",
                "description": "User principal name of the participant."
              },
              "role": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Role",
                "description": "Specifies the participant's role in the meeting. Possible values: attendee, presenter."
              }

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_OPEN_SHIFT
Tool to update an existing open shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to modify open shift details such as times, theme, notes, or open slot count.

**Input schema:**
```json
