## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_SCHEDULING_GROUP
Tool to replace/update a scheduling group in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing scheduling group such as display name, active status, code, or member list.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateSchedulingGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "scheduling_group_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$",
      "examples": [
        "MORNING1",
        "SUCCESS001",
        "WETEAM"
      ],
      "description": "Code or identifier for the scheduling group. This can be used for external system integration or quick reference. Must contain only alphanumeric characters (letters and numbers, no special characters or spaces)."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID/UUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "user_ids": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "User Ids",
      "examples": [
        [
          "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
        ],
        [
          "550ac91a-5895-4c98-af68-e97197a65af4",
          "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
        ],
        []
      ],
      "description": "List of user IDs to include as members of this scheduling group. Each ID should be a valid GUID/UUID. This replaces the existing list of members."
    },
    "is_active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Active",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Indicates whether the scheduling group is active and available for scheduling. Set to true to enable, false to disable."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Morning Shift",
        "Weekend Team",
        "Updated Scheduling Group"
      ],
      "description": "Display name of the scheduling group. This is the name that will appear when managing schedules and shifts."
    },
    "scheduling_group_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scheduling Group Id",
      "examples": [
        "TAG_dc93d488-40de-443e-ac7d-ce86f22bef80",
        "dc93d488-40de-443e-ac7d-ce86f22bef80"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the scheduling group to update. This can be a GUID or a tag-based ID (e.g., 'TAG_dc93d488-40de-443e-ac7d-ce86f22bef80')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for updating/replacing a scheduling group in a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_TIME_OFF
Tool to replace an existing timeOff entry in a team's schedule. Use when you need to update time off details including dates, reason, or status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTimeOffRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "timeoff_id",
    "userId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "userId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Id",
      "examples": [
        "43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f"
      ],
      "description": "ID of the user assigned to this timeOff entry. Must be a valid user GUID (e.g., '43f0c14d-bca8-421f-b762-c3d8dd75be1f'). Required."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "pattern": "^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "timeoff_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Timeoff Id",
      "examples": [
        "SHFT_d3b1de89-60b8-4e61-81b7-c55ab222c1ab"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the timeOff entry to replace. This is the ID of the timeOff resource in the team's schedule (e.g., 'SHFT_d3b1de89-60b8-4e61-81b7-c55ab222c1ab')."
    },
    "draftTimeOff": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TimeOffItem",
      "required": [
        "timeOffReasonId",
        "startDateTime",
        "endDateTime"
      ],
      "properties": {

            "white",
            "blue",
            "green",
            "purple",
            "pink",
            "yellow",

            "darkGreen",
            "darkPurple",
            "darkPink",
            "darkYellow"
          ],

          "title": "ScheduleEntityTheme",

            "green",
            "purple"
          ],
          "description": "Color theme values for schedule entities in Microsoft Teams."
        },
        "endDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "End Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2026-03-15T17:00:00Z",
            "2024-10-10T20:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The end date and time for the timeOff in ISO 8601 format. The Timestamp type is always in UTC time (e.g., '2026-03-15T17:00:00Z')."
        },
        "startDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2026-03-15T09:00:00Z",
            "2024-10-10T19:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The start date and time for the timeOff in ISO 8601 format. The Timestamp type is always in UTC time (e.g., '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z')."
        },
        "timeOffReasonId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Off Reason Id",
          "examples": [
            "TOR_891045ca-b5d2-406b-aa06-a3c8921245d7"
          ],
          "description": "ID of the timeOffReason for this timeOffItem. This references a predefined reason in the team's schedule. Format typically starts with 'TOR_' followed by a GUID (e.g., 'TOR_891045ca-b5d2-406b-aa06-a3c8921245d7')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents a version of the timeOff entry (shared or draft).",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "sharedTimeOff": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "TimeOffItem",
      "required": [
        "timeOffReasonId",
        "startDateTime",
        "endDateTime"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "theme": {
          "enum": [
            "white",
            "blue",
            "green",
            "purple",
            "pink",
            "yellow",
            "gray",
            "darkBlue",
            "darkGreen",
            "darkPurple",
            "darkPink",
            "darkYellow"
          ],
          "type": "string",
          "title": "ScheduleEntityTheme",
          "examples": [
            "blue",
            "green",
            "purple"
          ],
          "description": "Color theme values for schedule entities in Microsoft Teams."
        },
        "endDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "End Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2026-03-15T17:00:00Z",
            "2024-10-10T20:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The end date and time for the timeOff in ISO 8601 format. The Timestamp type is always in UTC time (e.g., '2026-03-15T17:00:00Z')."
        },
        "startDateTime": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Start Date Time",
          "examples": [
            "2026-03-15T09:00:00Z",
            "2024-10-10T19:00:00Z"
          ],
          "description": "The start date and time for the timeOff in ISO 8601 format. The Timestamp type is always in UTC time (e.g., '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z')."
        },
        "timeOffReasonId": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Time Off Reason Id",
          "examples": [
            "TOR_891045ca-b5d2-406b-aa06-a3c8921245d7"
          ],
          "description": "ID of the timeOffReason for this timeOffItem. This references a predefined reason in the team's schedule. Format typically starts with 'TOR_' followed by a GUID (e.g., 'TOR_891045ca-b5d2-406b-aa06-a3c8921245d7')."
        }
      },
      "description": "Represents a version of the timeOff entry (shared or draft).",
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "isStagedForDeletion": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Staged For Deletion",
      "description": "Indicates whether the timeOff is marked for deletion. This process is finalized when the schedule is shared. Optional."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request parameters for replacing an existing timeOff entry in a team's schedule."
}
```

## MICROSOFT_TEAMS_UPDATE_TIME_OFF_REASON
Tool to update a time off reason in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify the display name, icon, active status, or code of an existing time off reason.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTimeOffReasonRequest",
  "required": [
    "team_id",
    "time_off_reason_id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "code": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Code",
      "examples": [
        "MED2026",
        "VAC001",
        "PTO"
      ],
      "description": "An alphanumeric code to represent an external identifier for this time off reason. Must be unique within the team. Maximum 100 characters."
    },
    "team_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team Id",
      "examples": [
        "87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (GUID) of the Microsoft Teams team. Must be in UUID format (e.g., '87b0560f-fc0d-4442-add8-b380ca926707')."
    },
    "icon_type": {
      "enum": [
        "none",
        "car",
        "calendar",
        "running",
        "plane",
        "firstAid",
        "doctor",
        "notWorking",
        "clock",
        "juryDuty",
        "globe",
        "cup",
        "phone",
        "weather",
        "umbrella",
        "piggyBank",
        "dog",
        "cake",
        "trafficCone",
        "pin",
        "sunny"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TimeOffReasonIconType",
      "description": "Supported icon types for time off reasons."
    },
    "is_active": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Active",
      "description": "Whether the time off reason is active and can be used when creating or updating time off entries. Set to false to deactivate without deleting."
    },
    "display_name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display Name",
      "examples": [
        "Medical Leave",
        "Vacation",
        "Personal Time"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the time off reason. This is what will be displayed in the schedule."
    },
    "time_off_reason_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Time Off Reason Id",
      "examples": [
```
